sinopsis.es: En Svilengrad, un pueblo búlgaro de frontera, la arqueóloga Veska se cruza con Said, un viejo conocido al que le robaron el carro. Al reencontrarse, entra en el mundo turbio del que él viene y empieza a explorar los vínculos criminales que esconde el pueblo, mientras figuras de su propio pasado la cercan.
sinopsis.en: In Svilengrad, a small town on the Bulgarian border, Veska, an archaeologist, crosses paths with Said, an old acquaintance whose car has been stolen. As they reconnect, she is drawn into the shady world he comes from and begins to explore the criminal ties beneath the town’s surface, while figures from her own past close in.
